newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pixar '96 estimate raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pixar '96 estimate raised.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co analyst Keith Benjamin said he raised his 1996 earnings estimate for Pixar Animation Studios to $0.43 a share from $0.33 based on greater potential for the company's co-produced movie "Toy Story" as it moves from domestic theaters to overseas, CD-ROM and video.
-- Benjamin maintained a buy rating on the stock and his 1997 earnings estimate of $0.28 a share remains unchanged.
-- On Monday Pixar reported third quarter earnings of $0.21 a share on revenues of $13.8 million, versus a loss of $0.03 a share on revenue of $1.1 million a year ago.
